_comment: Sidecar config for frame-screenshots.py (Plan 5 Task 5). Ordered (input, headline) pairs plus per-shot chrome-crop overrides. Edit this file to re-run with new captures/copy - no code changes needed for the common case.

shots.headline: Live quakes worldwide
shots.note: Map + live magnitude-colored pins + live feed list underneath - the core landing pitch. crop_top removes the OS status bar (measured: uniform gray 0-108px on this device); crop_bottom removes the OS 3-button nav row (measured: solid band starts ~2296px), NOT the app's own Home/History/Insights tab bar, which stays.

shots.headline: Every quake, the full picture
shots.note: Detail sheet depth: magnitude, time, depth/distance/felt-it stats, honest tsunami line, Share/Dismiss. STALE re: the in-app News section (shipped Plan 4 Task 5, fixed Plan 5 Task 2b) - this capture predates News and shows none of it; headline was written to match what's actually pictured, not the full feature set. No populated-news device capture exists anywhere in this repo yet (only loading/hidden-after-429 states) - pipeline re-runs this slot once one is captured.

shots.headline: Trends at a glance
shots.note: Quakes-per-day chart, magnitude breakdown, strongest-quake card (30d window).

shots.headline: Nearby, defined by you
shots.note: Translucent radius ring overlay on the map at a user-chosen distance (500 km pictured), paired with the calm 'nothing nearby' pill.

shots.headline: The full quake archive
shots.note: History list with All/M4.5+/M6+ magnitude filters and year filters (2026/2025/All), a populated month section underneath.

shots.headline: Honest alerts
shots.note: Notification shade, 3 real M6+ digest alerts with honest per-item copy ('matches your worldwide M6+ alert rule'). No crop: this is the OS shade itself, not app content sitting under OS chrome - the clock/date and the gesture drag-handle at the bottom are real shade content, not a duplicated status/nav bar, so cropping them would cut real evidence instead of chrome.
